purpose: Modernise the Sweet Bank Android client to Kotlin 1.9+, AGP 8.x, and current AndroidX stack while preserving 1:1 parity with the Capability BRD.
current_state_summary: Kotlin 1.4.20 (deprecated). AGP 4.1.1 (EOL). Koin 2.2.1 with legacy Dagger remnants. jcenter() (sunset).
target_state_summary: Kotlin 1.9+, AGP 8.x, Koin 3.x, Retrofit 2.11+, Moshi 1.15+, MavenCentral. Crashlytics + snapshot test harness.
architecture_narrative: Multi-module Android app: app + 7 feature modules (account, dashboard, balance, network, payees, resources, support).
